model_claim_criterion: At least 1% prefill and TTFT in both independent brackets for that case, relevant drift <=3%. Other cases no worse than 1%. CPU cost reduction is measured separately.
limitations: Two retained samples per case/arm, clocks unlocked, no confidence interval
Payload benchmark measures CPU generation only, not model throughput
Replay does not regenerate local IDs; no decode/long-context speed claim
6561 slots is experiment capacity; production auto sizing/reserve unchanged
1Hz physical free memory is not instantaneous headroom or proof of no paging; READY uses a different counter
Historical benchmark cumulative MTP threshold 0 differs from production 0.5
adoption_criterion: Positive prefill and TTFT in both independent brackets, exact outputs and passed numerical checks; user accepts gains below 1%. The 1% repeat gate is for model claims, not source adoption.
